Hi mom! I need your help with something, but please don’t freak out.

I am in this abandoned house in the middle of nowhere. Please, don’t ask how I got here, because I can’t really tell you for now. Please PLEASE don’t ask!

I will send you the coordinates, can you or dad pick me up?

I am not in trouble or anything like this. Nobody abducted me, nobody hurt me. I’m FINE, ok? I just ended up here. By accident. Sort of.
